title: Local task evidence HTML overflows mobile viewport because footer report hash does not wrap
observation: On 2026-09-22, Playwright rendered the actual report htask_798fa5269bfc4f42467778d9 from Hunch 1.40.1. At viewport width 360px, document scrollWidth was 457px. DOM Range inspection identified the footer's unbroken sha256 report hash as the sole overflowing text. Temporarily applying footer overflow-wrap:anywhere reduced scrollWidth to 345px; restoring the original style restored 457px. Existing CSS only gives wrapping to pre, code and dd; the report hash is bare footer text. Desktop 1280px rendering had no horizontal overflow; details interaction worked.
evidence: src/core/taskReportRender.ts:89-90 wraps pre/code/dd but inserts the hash as bare footer text.

Playwright on actual local report served at loopback: viewport 360, scrollWidth 457; footer hash range right 457 and overflowWrap normal; temporary footer wrap reduced scrollWidth to 345, restoration returned 457.
